headline: CONTRA takes the sky — hangar gunships sortie at the gate
lede: The stage-1 fortress now grinds a bay door open in the parapet and launches an armoured attack plane that strafes the arena from above. The attack is announced by the door, its rounds fly shallow so a hop is always the answer, and three rounds bring the hull down in a named fireball — new art, synthesized engine and ratchet sounds, and 213 proof pins.

notes.text: The original's second air layer is in: telegraphed hangar sortie, one gunship at a time, lane-aimed shallow rounds, a shootable three-round airframe (+400), pierce one-take, and the sky empties at the falls and when the core dies.

Fairness finding that gated the merge: ramping sortie cadence by the full loop tempo killed the autopilot bank at the capped loops — the rounds stack where the wall leaves no road. The cadence ramp was halved (sortieK), loop 1 byte-identical, the bank clears 12/12 again, and the brain stayed untouched.
QA landed R-TYPE's fixed-spot Double & Speed Up pods mid-run (#2915 part 1) — the capsule spawn now reads the same on every seed.
The never-dry kick now points at R-TYPE; CONTRA's vertical set is complete and its remaining honest gaps are cosmetic.
